description: Synthetic labeled snippets for extraction evals. Companies and URLs are fictional (.example is a reserved TLD).

snippet.title: Corvid Labs releases Corvid 3
snippet.content: Corvid Labs on Tuesday released Corvid 3, a multimodal model that accepts text, images and audio. It is available today through the Corvid API and in the company's chat app, with a 1 million token context window.

snippet.title: Corvid Labs cuts Corvid 3 Mini API prices by 40%
snippet.content: Corvid Labs said it will cut API prices for Corvid 3 Mini by 40% effective March 1, bringing input tokens to $0.09 per million. The company said the cut reflects lower serving costs.

snippet.title: Corvid Labs could be weighing an acquisition, sources say
snippet.content: Corvid Labs may be exploring the purchase of a robotics startup, according to two people who asked not to be named. No deal has been agreed and talks could still collapse. Corvid Labs declined to comment.

cases.note: Rumor from unnamed sources; must not pass the confidence gate.

snippet.title: Corvid Labs hires Dana Reyes as COO
snippet.content: Corvid Labs named Dana Reyes, previously head of operations at a large cloud provider, as its chief operating officer. Reyes starts next month and will oversee go-to-market and infrastructure.

snippet.title: Nimbus AI expands; analysts compare it with Corvid Labs
snippet.content: Nimbus AI opened a new engineering hub this week. Analysts said the move puts Nimbus in closer competition with Corvid Labs, whose models remain popular with developers.

cases.note: Off-topic: the development belongs to Nimbus AI, not Corvid Labs.

snippet.title: Nimbus AI signs multi-year deal with Atlas Cloud
snippet.content: Nimbus AI and Atlas Cloud signed a multi-year agreement under which Atlas will host Nimbus models for its enterprise customers. Financial terms were not disclosed.

snippet.title: Nimbus AI opens Singapore office, adds APAC data residency
snippet.content: Nimbus AI opened its first Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and launched in-region data residency for customers in the region, the company announced.

snippet.title: Nimbus AI publishes paper on sparse attention training
snippet.content: Researchers at Nimbus AI published a paper describing a sparse attention training method that they say halves training compute at equal quality. The paper includes benchmark results and the code is on GitHub.

cases.note: Paper plus code; research, not a product.

snippet.title: Opinion: Nimbus AI's strategy might not work
snippet.content: In this column, our writer argues that Nimbus AI could struggle to differentiate if larger rivals keep cutting prices. This is an opinion piece; Nimbus AI has not announced any change in strategy.

snippet.title: Nimbus AI launches Nimbus Voice and raises Pro plan price
snippet.content: Nimbus AI launched Nimbus Voice, a real-time speech assistant, for all users on Thursday. In the same announcement the company said the Pro plan will rise from $20 to $25 a month for new subscribers.

cases.note: Two distinct developments in one snippet (tests recall).

snippet.title: Halyard Studio is now generally available
snippet.content: Halyard announced general availability of Halyard Studio, its agent-building workspace, after a six-month beta. Studio is included in all paid plans starting today.

snippet.title: Halyard CTO Sam Okafor steps down
snippet.content: Halyard said chief technology officer Sam Okafor is stepping down at the end of the quarter. The company has begun a search for a successor and the head of research will serve as interim CTO.

snippet.title: 10 AI tools to try this year
snippet.content: Our roundup of AI tools worth trying includes writing assistants, coding copilots and agent builders such as Halyard Studio, alongside a dozen other products.

snippet.title: Halyard partners with Meridian Health network
snippet.content: Halyard and the Meridian Health hospital network announced a partnership to pilot Halyard agents for clinical documentation across 12 hospitals, starting this spring.

snippet.title: Senior ML Engineer, Halyard
snippet.content: Halyard is hiring a senior machine learning engineer to work on evaluation infrastructure. Remote within the US. Apply via the careers page.

cases.note: Single job posting; not a competitive development.

snippet.title: Tessellate launches in Japan with Japanese-language model
snippet.content: Tessellate launched its assistant in Japan with a Japanese-language model and local billing in yen, its first market outside North America and Europe.

snippet.title: Tessellate introduces a free tier
snippet.content: Tessellate introduced a free tier for its API that includes 1 million tokens per month, alongside its existing paid plans, the company said on its blog.

snippet.title: Tessellate publishes model safety evaluation report
snippet.content: Tessellate published a 60-page report detailing safety evaluations of its latest model, including red-teaming results and the benchmarks it used.

snippet.title: Tessellate reportedly in talks to raise new funding
snippet.content: Tessellate is reportedly in early talks with investors about a new funding round, according to people familiar with the matter. The terms could change and no agreement has been reached.

snippet.title: Tessellate closes $200M Series C
snippet.content: Tessellate said it has closed a $200 million Series C round led by Northfield Ventures. The company plans to use the funds to expand its research team.

cases.note: Confirmed funding; no dedicated type, so 'other'.
